verdict.rationale: The evidence shows agents running locally to claim approved tasks and open PRs, plus a dashboard listing each worker's held task and last message. Nothing documents a way for a developer to take over, finish, or redirect an in-progress agent task from an editor, terminal, or browser. Monitoring workers and copying an intention into your own process are adjacent features, not a documented takeover capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work
